question: The Telangana state government started the ‘SAHAS’ initiative in 2023. Which of the following aims is related to the ‘SAHAS’ initiative?

options.text: To increase access to healthcare services
To make workplace safe for women
To create job opportunities for the youth

solution:
The correct answer is __**To make workplace safe for women**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Telangana state government launched the **'SAHAS'** initiative in 2023 with the aim to **make workplaces safe for women**.
